changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0021. Nutrition profile and daily food logs, plus AI conversations, messages, and usage. Nutrition and conversations are user-owned inside one tenant. Messages are reached from the conversation. Usage supports a database quota count. Index review: unique nutrition profile per user and tenant; IX_NutritionLogs_User_Date for the daily summary; IX_AiConversations_User_Updated and IX_AiMessages_Conversation_Created; IX_AiUsageRecords_User_Created for quota windows. Performance note: the daily summary sums one user and one date, and the quota counts one user from a date forward.

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE app.AiUsageRecords; DROP TABLE app.AiMessages; DROP TABLE app.AiConversations; DROP TABLE app.NutritionLogs; DROP TABLE app.NutritionProfiles;
